decisions.reason: The source policy also applies to the sensor board, but its existing message-507 MODIFY already fully captures the required bottom-side connector minimization.
The surrounding exchange concerns the vertically mounted main and sensor boards, not the separately arranged power board.
This connector belongs to the power board, while the source policy is established in the main-and-sensor-board enclosure-layout exchange.
The source changes physical connector placement policy, not the sensor-module connector inventory, types, pinouts, or count.
Bottom-side placement is already governed by the mechanical-layout Requirements and does not change the interboard connector types, pinouts, matching order, or power topology.
Connector accessibility does not change the I2C cable, speed, pull-up, or series-resistor requirements.
The source establishes a general main-board mechanical placement constraint but does not change the panel-button connector's type, board, signal connection, or control behavior.
Physical connector placement does not alter any ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment or compatibility rule.
The source does not change the BOOT control, reset wiring, or capacitance requirements; their physical placement remains governed by the main-board mechanical-layout constraint.
The bottom-side connector policy does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module.
The source does not change USB-C programming or enumeration behavior and does not specifically relocate the USB connector.
The mechanical connector-accessibility policy does not change the monitoring IC, measured rails, channel allocation, or measurement coverage.
